text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Whew, you really got me~. I'm 
thoroughly ashamed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I knew it was going to be tough from 
the very beginning, but...
choice_data_list: There were parts that went well too!

Let's overcome our weaknesses as soon as 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
choice_data_list: うまくいったところもあったよ！
早急に課題を克服しよう

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's not so much anxiety, but... Today's 
race just felt like I had zero traction...
choice_data_list: 何か不安なことがあるのか？
何か不安なことがあるの？

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Could we do a review together later?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I want to properly understand what went 
right and what went wrong in today's race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I don't want this loss to 
have been in vain, either.
choice_data_list:
I'll use today as fuel to make you 
absolutely stronger!

I'll use today as fuel to make you 
absolutely stronger!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
choice_data_list: 今日を糧に、君を絶対に強くする！
今日を糧に、貴方を絶対に強くするよ！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm really gonna hold you to that 
confidence, okay? I'll do my very best 
too...!"
